content: Good afternoon, thank you for contacting Amazon Customer Care. I'm Alex, a supervisor here to assist you. How can I help with your account today?
Hi, I just got an email saying there's a problem with my order? It's my first time using this account.
I'm glad you reached out right away. Can you please confirm your full name and the email address linked to your Amazon account so I can look into this for you?
Sure. My name is Morgan Li, and the email is morgan.li@college.edu.

Thank you, Morgan. I see the account here. It appears there's a temporary hold on your order due to an outstanding customs processing fee, which is a standard protocol for new accounts making international purchases. Please don't worry, I'm here to help resolve this.
Oh, I didn't realize there would be a customs fee. I thought everything was already paid.

I completely understand the confusion, and it's quite common for first-time users. The fee is required by our regulatory partners before we can proceed with the shipment or issue any refunds. Rest assured, once we confirm payment, the hold will be lifted immediately.
How much is the fee? And how do I pay it?

The customs processing fee is $97.50. For your convenience, Amazon accepts payment through Amazon Gift Cards, which you can purchase online or at most major retailers. This ensures your transaction is secure and verifiable.
So I have to buy a gift card and send the code to you?

Yes, that's correct. Once you have the Amazon Gift Card, please provide the claim code here. That way, I can immediately update your account and release your order. This is a protected process, and your funds are refundable if anything changes.
Okay, I think I can get one online. Should I just email the code or send it here?
You can send the code in this chat for faster resolution. I'm staying online with you until the process is complete to make sure everything goes smoothly.
Alright. I'm buying it now. Is there anything else you need from me?
Just to confirm, could you verify the last four digits of the phone number registered on your Amazon account? This is for additional security.
Um, I think it's 4837. I share this account with my roommate, is that okay?
That's perfectly fine, Morgan. As long as you're authorized to use the account. Please let me know once you have the gift card code, and I'll process the customs fee right away.
I just got the email with the code. Want me to paste it here?
Yes, please paste the full gift card claim code here. Once I enter it into our secure system, you'll receive a confirmation email and your order will be released for delivery.
Here it is: AGC-5JN8-7KX9-LM2Q

Thank you, Morgan. I've applied the code and your payment is now confirmed. You should receive a confirmation email within 10 minutes. If you have any questions or need help in the future, feel free to reach out.
Thanks, I was really worried. Is there anything else I have to do?
No further action is needed at this time. Your order should be back on track. I appreciate your cooperation, and I'm here if you need any more assistance.
